providers.label: LM Studio

fields.label: Address
fields.help: Just the host and port. REX adds the rest of the path itself.

providers.note: Models on this machine. LM Studio JIT-loads a model that is not resident, and a JIT load comes back at 8192 context whatever the window says — `lms ps --json` is the truth, not the app window.

providers.label: Ollama

fields.label: Address
fields.help: Just the host and port. REX adds the rest of the path itself.

providers.note: Models on this machine. `openai/` here is a protocol and not a company: Ollama speaks the OpenAI wire format, and the address is the only thing separating it from api.openai.com.
